name: LocalResponseNormQ8

provenance.symbol: LRN normalization formula; channel loop corrected to the public operator definition

adaptation:
Cross-channel local response normalization on NCHW [1,5,2,2] signed INT8 feature values.

For each channel c and spatial location p independently, S[c,p] is the sum of X[j,p]^2 for j=max(0,c-1)..min(4,c+1), inclusive. Missing edge channels contribute zero; the normalization constant does not change at channel edges. Return Y[c,p]=round_nearest_ties_away(256*16384*X[c,p]/(16384+S[c,p])). Output has the same NCHW order, twenty signed INT16 lanes in units 1/256. This is ONNX LRN with size=3, bias=1, alpha=3/16384 and beta=1, followed by explicit fixed-point rounding. There is no square root, subtraction of a channel mean, or spatial pooling. All twenty outputs are required. The denominator is always positive and all outputs fit INT16. The pinned Python reference has a loop-bound defect (batch count used instead of channel count); this task implements all channels according to the LRN operator definition, not that defect.
